policy.world_selection: First two fact and first two rule dev worlds sorted by world_id
policy.score: Equal weight known/fact/rule groups; mean candidate/strict_EM minus language and keep NLL residual above .1 nats. Equal weight doses, tie prefers L.
policy.late_improvement: If either architecture improves dev score by >.01 from 2048 to 2560, extend BOTH once by 64x16, then reevaluate.

limitations: Saved evidence audit only; no independent model forward, tokenizer, derivative or language per-token recomputation.
Development selection from one phi training seed; no formal test or independent-seed efficacy conclusion.
Known task shares its query pool with keep; rule tasks have four queries within the support range.
A selected architecture still requires organization adaptation and matched phi_clean before formal freezing.
